539-997-1462-3821-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-997-1462-3821-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat

971-3755-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-3755-4687.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1170-1594-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

728-5170-6094-6132.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2604-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ugin, the Ineffable.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

5220-6797-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
5220-6797-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

2021-2060-6774-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

141-3967-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-3967-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-4460.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

333-997-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Shepherd of the Cosmos
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Saffi triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

4284-5282-7149.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clone dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Clone enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clone from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5101-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {6}{G}{U}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5101-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Merfolk Skydiver by paying {3}{G}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

918-1640-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Donna Noble instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

2060-3750-4120-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-3750-4120-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
2060-3750-4120-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, attempting to deal 100 damage to Crystalline Crawler, which will result in 100 +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
2060-3750-4120-6758.notes: As long as Crystalline Crawler has enough +1/+1 counters on it, you do not need to target it in step 1, allowing you to put +1/+1 counters on other creatures you control if desired.

725-4050-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
725-4050-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

678-6749-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-6749-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

109-6790.manaNeeded: {R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
109-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
109-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Fork by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Fork, with the copy targeting the original Fork.
Resolve the copy of Fork, creating a copy of Fork targeting the original Fork.
Repeat step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3226-4613-4968.description:
Activate Blood Researcher by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Blood Researcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

292-2265-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2265-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1283-4853-4888-5231.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {1}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Repeat.

730-1479-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
730-1479-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

575-4319-5226-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-5226-5441.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

1003-3156-3558-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
1003-3156-3558-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Scholar on the battlefield as Jetfire, Air Guardian.
Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-3490-4050.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1310-1766-2816.notablePrerequisites: Thran Dynamo does not have summoning sickness.
1310-1766-2816.description:
Cast Karn's Touch by paying {U}{U}, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Thran Dynamo.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3911-4235-4563.notablePrerequisites: At least six charge counters on Everflowing Chalice.
3911-4235-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalince by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it.
When you activate Galvanic Key, Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy that ability.
Resolve one copy of the Galvanic Key ability, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.

2026-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
2026-3664-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.

224-2248-3478.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
